tri_state.maybe_meaning: unresolved provenance; not a third probabilistic truth value

merkle.digest: SHA-256 over canonical JSON node payload

backdraft.rule: on MAYBE, follow parent hashes backward until resolved provenance is found, then replay deterministic edge operations forward
backdraft.conflict_rule: if merge/co-op parent projections disagree, resolution fails closed

graph_ops.branch: one lineage continues to an addressed child without erasing provenance
graph_ops.fork: one parent produces opposed children through deterministic edge operations
graph_ops.merge: distinct histories converge only when their projected resolved states agree
graph_ops.coop: multiple parent histories synchronize only when their projected resolved states agree

qk_bolt.fill_rule: resolve each ? left-to-right from a supplied Merkle proof target

scope: repository-defined deterministic/Merkle simulation semantics; MAYBE represents missing provenance rather than physical indeterminacy
